sections.heading: Overview
bullets: Escort Scholar Glenna through the stronghold, capturing 5 towers along the way. No time limit — it fails if Glenna dies or the squad wipes.

sections.heading: Protecting Glenna
bullets: Glenna has Surveilled stacks that drain when no one's near her — at zero stacks, 5 White Mantle Seekers spawn and can burst her down fast. Stay with her.

After each tower capture, two Warg Bloodhounds spawn (one at the entrance, one further up the path) and beeline straight for Glenna — they can kill her in 1-2 hits if unchecked. Float is the reliable hard CC on them.
The path has scattered mines: white ones are safe to target, red ones detonate — watch your footing.

sections.heading: Tower captures
bullets: 5 towers need capturing — you need more players in the capture zone than defending enemies, so don't spread the whole squad too thin at once.
